page_title: RMA 1-1 ATM | Real Madrid v Atletico Madrid 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+2' Today's referee Cesar Soto Grado rightly decides to book Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) for his harsh tackle.
90+2' Flag goes up against Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
88' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrygo.
86' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
83' Good chance for Rodrygo (Real Madrid) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the left post.
82' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
81' Substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
81' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Lucas Vazquez is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
80' Dani Ceballos comes off the pitch to be replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
80' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) jumps into a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul.

79' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
77' Substitution. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) in, Rodrigo de Paul out.
76' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
75' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
73' The resulting corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.

72' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot into the roof of the net as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
72' A pass into the box finds Rodrygo (Real Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jan Oblak denies him.
70' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Jan Oblak.
68' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
68' The attendance is 78082.
68' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.

68' Great save! Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Jan Oblak. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) horribly skewed a first-time shot from the edge of the box and sent the ball way wide of the right post.
65' It's a nice effort by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Jan Oblak. Easy save.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Javi Galan leaves the pitch and Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
64' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) replaces Giuliano Simeone.
64' That's the end of the game for Samuel Lino, who is replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).
62' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for an infringement.
61' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
60' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by the goalkeeper.
59' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
58' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Jan Oblak.
57' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
57' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
57' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
55' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

55' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
54' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
52' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle.
51' What a chance that is! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the left side of the net.
50' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
49' The foul by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Cesar Soto Grado.
49' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Giuliano Simeone, but he puts too much power on the pass.
47' A cross into the box from Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is cleared.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
45+3' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for holding. Cesar Soto Grado signals a set piece.
45+2' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Jan Oblak comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
44' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
42' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
41' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
40' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
39' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) attempts to release Rodrygo with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
38' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
37' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
35' 0 - 1 Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Thibaut Courtois to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
35' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
34' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
32' Referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
32' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
31' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
30' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
28' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
26' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
25' Cesar Soto Grado shows the yellow card to Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
25' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
24' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
23' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
22' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Madrid have a corner.
21' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
20' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
18' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
17' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
15' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
12' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
10' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) and Vinicius Junior attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
8' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
7' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
6' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
5' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it.
4' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
2' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado is introduced as the referee for today's match.
